decisions.reason: As a very recent launch close to our core hearing-business offer, we would keep it because the investment is still fresh and any weaker start can be attributed to normal market adoption rather than product failure.

We would keep Product B because it is tightly aligned with our established custom hearing solutions and was publicly promoted on its own page, which increases our commitment to continue supporting it.

We would keep Product C because it fits our established equipment portfolio and our stated push for improved production workflows, making it a product management is likely to back despite any early uncertainty.
